text:
All 10 tests pass. Fixes in `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — order-preserving de-dupe (track seen items) instead of `list(set(...))`
2. **`partition`** — return `(matches, non-matches)` instead of the reverse
3. **`windows`** — use `range(0, len(items) - k + 1)` so the final window is included
